_note: Naming. Noun = the form (husk). With an echo present, the echo names it (it's the spice). With no echo, the name BLENDS the top two stats when the 2nd is within blend_threshold of the 1st (e.g. 'Brutal-Fleet Skeleton') instead of majority-wins. blend_threshold 1.0 = near-equal only, lower = blends more eagerly.
